name: Net Leverage
standard: Time removed from Leo's week exceeds model cost plus supervision, correction, and recovery time.
test: Reconcile owned work, review time, correction time, model cost, and recovered time from an auditable weekly ledger.

metric.name: net_leverage_hours
metric.unit: owned-work hours minus supervision and correction hours; costs remain separately reported

claim_boundary: A ledger result is an observation for that week, not a forecast of future savings.
